A young man (left) in riding dress, faces two money-lenders (right); all are seated beside a table on which is a coffee-pot, cup, &c. He leans back in a nonchalant attitude, his riding-whip in his right hand, his left held out towards the usurers. Both usurers are gnarled and elderly, one, with the beard and profile of a Jew, is reading a large deed with pendent seals.
